اغتظت (form VIII)
# اِغْتَظْتُ (iḡtaẓtu) /iɣ.taðˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِغْتَاظَ (iḡtāẓa)
# اِغْتَظْتَ (iḡtaẓta) /iɣ.taðˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِغْتَاظَ (iḡtāẓa)
# اِغْتَظْتِ (iḡtaẓti) /iɣ.taðˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِغْتَاظَ (iḡtāẓa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
